# skills Usage Guide

<!-- socrates:section id="purpose" kind="purpose" tags="tools" -->
## Purpose

- `skills`: List, describe, or read supporting files from installed Socrates skills in builtin, global, and project roots. Use list to discover exact ids, describe to load SKILL.md, and read for an exact referenced supporting path. This specialized-agent surface cannot import or mutate skills.
<!-- /socrates:section -->

<!-- socrates:section id="when_to_use" kind="routing" tags="tools" -->
## When To Use

- Use `skills` when the active task requires its cataloged read/retrieval capability.
<!-- /socrates:section -->

<!-- socrates:section id="inputs" kind="schema" tags="tools" -->
## Inputs

- `skills` uses the one canonical schema owned by `tool.skills.read`; send only documented fields and do not add aliases or placeholder values.
<!-- /socrates:section -->

## Workflow

1. Select `skills` only for the behavior described above, pass an exact valid input, and use its persisted result as evidence before continuing.
